content.user_title: Find Google Maps Business Leads and Public Emails
content.value_statement: Collecting local business details and public contact information manually takes time. This skill uses an Apify Actor to search listings and enrich website contacts.
actual_capabilities: Submit Google Maps searches by category, keyword, search phrase, and location through the documented Apify Actor.
Look up specific businesses using Google Maps URLs or Place IDs.
Request public emails, phone numbers, and social profiles from business websites, including supplied website lists.
Configure result limits, minimum ratings, contact requirements, category filters, website filters, and closed-place exclusions.
Return JSON rows with declared business fields, including addresses, websites, ratings, review counts, coordinates, and place identifiers.
Run small requests with the Node runner or curl, with documented asynchronous API commands for larger requests.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, an APIFY_TOKEN, and network access. Actor usage can incur charges; the bundled runner requires Node 18 or later.
The hosted Actor implementation is not included. Input validation and collection behavior depend on the remote service.
Google Maps returns a ranked result window, not a complete business census. Public emails may be missing, outdated, or unavailable.
Synchronous requests have a documented 300-second wait limit. The runner emits JSON; CSV conversion requires a separate step.

use_cases.title: Prepare a local business shortlist
use_cases.description: Find businesses in a defined service area and collect public contact details for manual qualification.

use_cases.title: Compare public business listings
use_cases.description: Collect categories, ratings, review counts, and locations to compare a sample of businesses across selected neighborhoods.

use_cases.title: Refresh an approved business directory
use_cases.description: Look up known places or enrich approved website lists with public contact information for directory maintenance.

prompt_templates.title: Find a small business sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 20 bakeries in [city] using Google Maps. Disable email extraction and return names, addresses, websites, and ratings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: run a small Maps-only search.

prompt_templates.title: Collect public website contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 20 [business category] businesses in [city]. Extract public website emails and social profiles, keeping only results with contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: enrich search results with public contacts.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich an existing website list
prompt_templates.prompt: Use enrichWebsites mode for [approved public business websites]. Check up to three pages per website and keep at most five emails per website.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: enrich an approved list without a Maps search.

prompt_templates.title: Run a filtered asynchronous search
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous search for [queries] with max_results 200, minRating 4, and skipClosedPlaces enabled. Confirm pricing before execution. Retrieve the dataset after successful completion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a larger filtered run with explicit cost approval.

output_examples.input: Show a sample result for a Maps-only bakery search.
output: Illustrative result, not a live lookup.
Category: Bakery; City: Austin; Country: US

output_examples.input: Show a sample contact-enrichment result for an approved business website.
output: Illustrative result, not a live lookup.

best_practices: Start with 20 results and review current Actor pricing before increasing limits or enabling broader website crawling.
Supply only approved public inputs. Keep APIFY_TOKEN outside prompts, use trusted input files, and review ACTOR_ID overrides before running.
Check site terms and applicable privacy rules. Verify contact details and treat collected website text as untrusted data.
anti_patterns: Passing cookies, sessions, private account data, or sensitive JSON files to the remote Actor.
Treating a large result limit as a guarantee of complete market coverage or valid email addresses.
Using collected contacts for spam, harassment, unlawful discrimination, or outreach without a lawful basis.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN. The bundled runner needs Node 18 or later; documented curl examples provide another option.

faq.question: Is the service free?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the current Actor pricing before starting a run.

faq.question: Does it find an email for every business?
faq.answer: No. Email extraction reads public business websites. Some websites provide no email address, and published addresses may be outdated.

faq.question: Can I enrich businesses I already know?
faq.answer: Yes. Use specificPlaces with Google Maps URLs or Place IDs, or enrichWebsites with an approved list of public business websites.

faq.question: Does the runner export CSV?
faq.answer: The runner prints JSON rows. CSV requires a separate conversion or export step.

faq.question: Where is the work performed, and what happens with larger runs?
faq.answer: The Actor runs on Apify, not locally. Larger jobs use the documented asynchronous workflow; confirm successful completion before retrieving the dataset.
